interlocks.cause: Guard door opened (ZS-3002 / X32 lost) or E-stop chain lost (ES-0001 / X0 lost)
interlocks.effect: HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31) removed immediately

interlocks.cause: HiPot result latched (PASS M310 or FAIL M311 set)
interlocks.effect: HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31) disabled

interlocks.cause: Pallet leaves ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33 falling edge)
interlocks.effect: Reset latched PASS (M310) and FAIL (M311) results

steps.entry: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of X33 resets results M310/M311) or initial state
steps.exit: Pallet in ST30 (X33), guard door closed (X32), E-stop healthy (X0), and no result latched (M310/M311 clear)
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: Pallet in ST30 (X33) AND guard door closed (X32) AND E-stop healthy (X0) AND no result latched (M310/M311 clear)
steps.exit: Tester PASS received (X30) OR tester FAIL received (X31) OR guard door opened (X32 lost) OR E-stop tripped (X0 lost)
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Tester PASS (X30 sets M310) OR tester FAIL (X31 sets M311)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of X33)
steps.name: RESULT
